title: Data-Driven Measures of High-Frequency Trading
abstract: arXiv:2608.00858v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Public data do not identify high-frequency trading (HFT), and standard proxies do not separate liquidity-supplying from liquidity-demanding strategies. We overcome this measurement challenge by training machine learning models on proprietary Nasdaq data to map observed HFT activity to public intraday variables. Applying this mapping, we generate daily measures of liquidity-supplying and liquidity-demanding HFT for all U.S. stocks from 2010 to 2023. The measures largely subsume standard proxies and capture time-series variation that those proxies miss. Using proprietary Euronext Paris data, we provide evidence that the approach generalizes across markets and remains predictive years after training. The 14-year panel lets us study HFT and market quality over time. translated_title: 数据驱动的高频交易度量方法
translated_abstract: 公开数据无法识别高频交易（HFT），而标准的替代指标也无法区分提供流动性与消耗流动性的策略。我们通过在纳斯达克专有数据上训练机器学习模型，将观测到的高频交易活动映射到公开的日内变量，从而克服了这一度量难题。应用这一映射关系，我们生成了2010年至2023年期间所有美国股票的流动性提供型和流动性消耗型高频交易的日度度量指标。这些度量指标在很大程度上涵盖了现有的标准替代指标，并捕捉到了那些指标所遗漏的时间序列变化。利用泛欧交易所巴黎市场的专有数据，我们提供了证据表明该方法可以推广到不同市场，并且在模型训练完成多年后仍保持预测能力。这一长达14年的面板数据使我们能够研究高频交易与市场质量随时间的演变关系。供给侧高频交易始终与更多的公告前信息获取、更多的知情交易以及更低的买卖价差相关联，而需求侧高频交易则是（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文通过在纳斯达克专有数据上训练机器学习模型，将高频交易活动映射到公开日内变量，首次构建了2010至2023年美国全部股票区分流动性提供型与流动性消耗型高频交易的日度度量指标，并发现供给侧高频交易与更多信息获取、更多知情交易和更低买卖价差相关。
en_tdlr: This paper trains machine learning models on proprietary Nasdaq data to map observed HFT activity to public intraday variables, generating novel daily measures of liquidity-supplying and liquidity-demanding HFT for all U.S. stocks from 2010 to 2023, and finds that supply-side HFT is consistently associated with greater pre-announcement information acquisition, more informed trading, and lower bid-ask spreads.
